group.name: Keycaps drawn on the list rows

plugin.name: SkyUI
plugin.description:
Keycaps built from SkyUI's own button art. The right choice for a plain SkyUI setup and for most UI overhauls, which are SkyUI reskins.
Art by the SkyUI Team.

plugin.name: Untarnished UI
plugin.description:
Keycaps built from Untarnished UI's own favorites menu, so they match that skin. Pick this one only if Untarnished UI is installed.
Art by Vor/Vorganger, uranreactor and the SkyUI Team.

plugin.name: None
plugin.description: No keycaps SWF. The hotkeys work exactly the same; the list rows simply show no key. Choose this if you want to drop in your own Interface/STB_Keycaps.swf -- see the adaptation guide in the mod's repository.
